heading: Moon & icon: Menphina's Medallion, round three
intro:
You kept concept D and set A, B and C aside. Round three enhances D with the feedback you passed on and the panel's fixes. A realism supervisor then checked every glyph and the icon for light, shadow, reflection, colour and material before anything reached this page.

What you asked for: the aetheryte crystal is gone, and all eight medals now share one gilt rim. States are told apart by what is inside the medal, not by the colour of its border. D is also richer: one light from the upper left on everything, the moon road redrawn as real ripples, and the lantern casting its own warm reflection.

Nothing is final. Vote or comment on the round-three card, and try the moons in the working mock of the plugin below.

before.name: Round two D
before.text: The panel's lead: 6.9 for glyphs and 7.5 for the icon. At 16 px it had rims in three colours (gilt, pewter and red), an aetheryte crystal on the island, and rows that read as radio buttons.

concepts.name: Menphina's Medallion, enhanced
concepts.pitch: Every quest state is a minted FFXIV job-icon medal: a moon emblem on lapis enamel in one shared champagne-gilt bevel. The icon is the moon road on calm water past a stone lantern, with each light reflected directly beneath it.
changes: Aetheryte crystal removed; the far shore is an unlit headland, so the only lights are the moon and the lantern
One shared gilt rim on all eight medals and the icon frame, lit from the upper left
Ready: the bezel opens at the bottom and the moon road spills out of it, so it reads by shape alone
Ready on another job: a violet soul crystal in a gilt setting, after the job stones
The check moved to Completed; Done this cycle has a gilt arc meaning it comes back
Locked out: a cracked Dalamud in rose-crimson, matching the plugin's Eclipse colour
Not checked: one tapered mist wisp over a hazy moon, with no ring
Icon: a 12-row moon road brightest at the moon's mirror point, a warm lantern reflection, and moon and road kept clear of the Installed check
watch: The weakest pair (Blocked vs Locked out, 12.8) clears the bar, but only just
Done this cycle's arc is new, so the panel needs to confirm it doesn't read as a bracket
Ready on a bright daylight ground relies on its open bezel more than on contrast

supervisor.summary:
The supervisor checked rendered images, never source, against one rule: realistic light, shadow, reflection, colour and material, even in stylised art.

  • Art, round one: 14 fixes. Mirror slices were moved to the mirror point. The road was re-spaced so it foreshortens. Glints became thin streaks. The lantern got its own warm reflection. The sky gradient was un-inverted. The ribbon was folded behind the medal. The check now breaks the rim.
  • Art, round two: one fix. The lantern's light pool moved in front of its base, where the light can actually reach.
  • Plugin mock: 16 fixes, then 2. The mock now matches the real 1.10 window: overlay content, the colour of the state words, quick views, the three-row action bar, and an ImGui look with no window shadows. The game-screen credit stays visible at every size.

Full reviews: docs/design/moon-v6/round3/supervisor/.
